verdict.line: You lose if you tongue-lash into her up Riposte and eat a free parry reset; you win by hitting level 6 Devour before her Blade Waltz comes online.

brief.thesis: This is a stack-and-swallow matchup: Tahm Kench's entire kill pattern runs through landing Q (Tongue Lash) to build An Acquired Taste stacks and then R (Devour) her for burst, but Fiora's W (Riposte) punishes exactly that Q poke if she times it. The 53.2% win rate over 205 games says Tahm wins the patient version of this lane, not the impatient one.

theirWindow.what: Do not throw Q (Tongue Lash) into her — if she pops W she parries the auto/Q-adjacent trade and reflects magic damage back, deleting your stack progress and chunking you for free.

yourWindow.when: Riposte is on cooldown (10-6s) or she just used it
yourWindow.what: This is your window to land Q (Tongue Lash) for the slow, heal, and stack, then follow with autos and W (Abyssal Dive) if she's out of position — she has no parry to punish the engage.

powerCurve.note: Lunge poke outranges your early trades
Second Wind sustain offsets her Duelist healing
Devour online, she lacks Riposte uptime to cover both

start.why: The flat damage reduction on autos directly dampens Fiora's Lunge pokes and stacking Duelist sustain, and it's the 52.6% winrate, 79% pick start in this matchup for a reason.

boots.why: 56.1% win rate over 171 games — the auto-attack damage reduction is built for a lane defined by her landing repeated Lunge/auto trades on you.

core.why: Stacking health directly scales your passive's bonus damage and your E (Thick Skin) shield pool, which is what wins the stat-check once Devour is live.
Core second item in both top build paths (92.9% and 52.9% sample win rates) — keeps your health scaling and sustain climbing before her damage spikes at 9-11.
80% win rate in the Bramble Vest into Thornmail line — grievous wounds directly cuts the Duelist healing stacks she's building off you all lane.

situational.when: she builds lifesteal/grievous-wounds-immune items and you need more raw healing amplification on your own sustain
you're getting outpaced in lane by her auto-reset pattern and need the early grievous wounds proc sooner than core Thornmail timing
you're comfortably ahead and want to snowball stacks into an early power spike before finishing Heartsteel

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp triggers on landed autos and scales off your max health, which is the exact stat Heartsteel and Dusk and Dawn are building toward — it's the 53.7%, 44.9%-pick page for this matchup.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport sits at 51% win rate with 18.3% pick — Teleport lets you reset top after short-trading rather than all-inning into her Riposte window, which matches the patient, stack-first game plan this matchup rewards.

playing.title: Bait Riposte before committing Q
playing.detail: Throw an auto or minion-focused trade first to see if she pops W (Riposte); once it's down, land Q (Tongue Lash) freely for the slow and stack without fear of the parry.

playing.title: Track stacks to three
playing.detail: An Acquired Taste caps at 3 stacks — your third landed Q stuns her and consumes the stacks, so time that stun to line up with your all-in, not a random poke.

playing.title: Devour the instant it's live
playing.detail: R (Devour) has 0 base cooldown once she's at 3 stacks — swallow immediately rather than waiting, since OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to use W before her Riposte and follow with Q into the swallow.

playing.title: Respect Blade Waltz from level 9
playing.detail: Her R (Blade Waltz) dashes to every nearby enemy champion dealing physical damage with diminishing returns per hit — don't overextend alone once she's 9+ even if you're ahead on stacks.

playing.title: Use E proactively, not reactively
playing.detail: E (Thick Skin) stores damage passively while out of combat and converts it to a shield on activation — pop it before trades to bank the shield rather than waiting until you're already low.

playing.title: Punish her E engage timing
playing.detail: Her E (Burst of Speed) only grants bonus move speed on landed attacks/Lunges — if she whiffs the engage, that's your cue to Q and start your own stack-building trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning on ability timings and trade windows is this coach's own read.

stats.opponentTip: Use [Q] and [W] carefully due to Fiora’s (W). After stacking up 3 (P) stacks, it’s a matter of skills due to her (W). Try to use [W] before she uses (W) or when (W) is on cooldown to swallow her, and follow up with [Q].
